originalTitle: Trustmark (TRMK): Buy, Sell, or Hold Post Q2 Earnings?
summary: Trustmark has followed the market’s trajectory closely, rising in tandem with the S&P 500 over the past six months. The stock has climbed by 8.4% to $48.43 per share while the index has gained 11.7%.
content:
Trustmark has followed the market's trajectory closely, rising in tandem with the S&P 500 over the past six months. The stock has climbed by 8.4% to $48.43 per share while the index has gained 11.7%.

Is now the time to buy Trustmark, or should you be careful about including it in your portfolio? See what our analysts have to say in our full research report, it's free .

We're passing on Trustmark for now. Here are three reasons why there are better opportunities than TRMK, plus one stock we'd rather own.

1. Net Interest Income Points to Soft Demand

Markets consistently prioritize net interest income over non-recurring fees, recognizing its superior quality compared to the more unpredictable revenue streams.

Trustmark's net interest income has grown at a 8.6% annualized rate over the last five years, slightly worse than the broader banking industry. Its growth was driven by both an increase in its outstanding loans and net interest margin, which represents how much a bank earns in relation to its outstanding loan book.

2. Projected Net Interest Income Growth Is Slim

Forecasted net interest income by Wall Street analysts signals a company's potential. Predictions may not always be accurate, but accelerating growth typically boosts valuation multiples and stock prices while slowing growth does the opposite.

Over the next 12 months, sell-side analysts expect Trustmark's net interest income to rise by 4.1%, a deceleration versus its 9.9% annualized growth for the past two years. This projection is below its 9.9% annualized growth rate for the past two years.

Analyzing the long-term change in earnings per share (EPS) shows whether a company's incremental sales were profitable — for example, revenue could be inflated through excessive spending on advertising and promotions.

Trustmark's weak 3.9% annual EPS growth over the last five years aligns with its revenue performance. This tells us it maintained its per-share profitability as it expanded.

Trustmark's business quality ultimately falls short of our standards. That said, the stock currently trades at 1.3× forward P/B (or $48.43 per share). This valuation multiple is fair, but we don't have much faith in the company. We're fairly confident there are better stocks to buy right now. 我们现在正在传递 Trustmark。以下是为什么有比 TRMK 更好的机会的三个原因，以及我们宁愿持有的一只股票。

1.净利息收入表明需求疲软

市场始终将净利息收入置于非经常性费用之上，认识到与更难以预测的收入流相比，净利息收入具有卓越的质量。

Trustmark 的净利息收入在过去五年中以年化 8.6% 的速度增长，略逊于整个银行业。其增长是由未偿贷款和净息差的增加推动的，净息差代表银行相对于其未偿贷款账面的收入。

2.预计净利息收入增长缓慢

华尔街分析师预测的净利息收入表明了公司的潜力。预测可能并不总是准确的，但加速增长通常会推高估值倍数和股价，而放缓增长则相反。

卖方分析师预计，未来 12 个月，Trustmark 的净利息收入将增长 4.1%，较过去两年 9.9% 的年化增长率有所放缓。这一预测低于过去两年 9.9% 的年化增长率。

分析每股收益 (EPS) 的长期变化可以显示公司的增量销售是否有利可图，例如，广告和促销方面的过度支出可能会夸大收入。

Trustmark 过去五年每股收益年增长率仅为 3.9%，这与其营收表现相符。这告诉我们，它在扩张过程中保持了每股盈利能力。

Trustmark 的业务质量最终没有达到我们的标准。也就是说，该股目前的交易价格为 1.3 倍远期市净率（即每股 48.43 美元）。这个估值倍数是公平的，但我们对公司没有太大信心。我们相当有信心现在有更好的股票可供购买。让我们向您介绍一个驾驭创作者经济的顶级数字广告平台。
